name: Cloady Free
free_limit: 0.5 vCPU, 1 GB RAM and 5 GB persistent SSD shared by apps in a workspace; 200 GB traffic
watch_out: No guaranteed service level; one subscription covers every region, but phone/SMS verification is required once per account before dashboard/API access. Exceeding any free resource threshold makes the full workspace capacity billable, not just the excess; a payment method is required to deploy paid resources. Optional managed backups cost extra; commercial-use and idle-expiry terms should be confirmed.
